contract.ownership: agent_mail owns tenant agent_mail lifecycle. health_db.init_db installs schema and INSERT OR IGNORE system_config seed. jobs/scheduled invokes public operations; integrity_tests consumes mail_dir and unacked_count.
contract.input: Tenant comes from process paths only. Bridge filenames, envelope identity, field types, status vocabulary and recipient coverage validated. No sender accepted by send. kind follows wire contract. Body >8000 characters before or after redaction raises ValueError. Optional task_ids for kind=task only: nonempty list of positive non-bool integers. hand_over stores these links in detail before publication; task_handover_times returns the first request UTC epoch for each linked task regardless of transport/ack state. No body or task IDs added to wire payload.
contract.output: send returns request id. pull_inbox returns validated pending dictionaries including transient wrapped; rows have metadata only. Duplicate (direction,message_id) does not insert or redeliver acknowledged mail. Same message_id under a different key is a loud error.
contract.state: out: requested -> sent:delivered|sent:failed|refused (request_failed on publication OSError). in: received -> shown (taken by health, shown_at persisted; no Telegram echo since 06.11) -> acked (ack file published). acked means health queued acknowledgement, not proof bridge moved it to acked/.
contract.effects: Atomic tmp+replace for out and ack. Bodies never in SQLite or logs. delivery_slot serializes delivery with a nonblocking tenant-local flock in DB directory. One process consumes a tenant directory.
contract.time: UTC epoch seconds; created_at is ingestion/request time. detail.shown_at is the durable rolling-hour quota timestamp. ack retry does not reset quota time. Received or shown older than 1800s is unacked.
contract.failures: Missing/incomplete mount, malformed files, unavailable DB/config/secret scan fail loudly. Files retained. shown retries ack without resending. Death between record_taken and reply loses that reply (acked, fault not raised): no exactly-once claim. Crash between requested commit and file publication can leave an unpublished request; inspect out/sent by id, do not resend automatically. fault_reported is committed before notify.fault: at most one attempt, crash in that gap can lose that journal notification.
contract.privacy: No LLM or post.py calls. Foreign-owner recipient enforcement belongs exclusively to host bridge. Redaction is the existing dictionary-based mechanism; no new clinical data export policy is added. Incoming text is shown as untrusted plain text.

items.D1: One domain: tenant mail lifecycle over a bridge spool and metadata ledger; no Telegram transport (owner sees the post office).
items.D2: Explicit public operations listed above. Helpers private; record_taken persists intake, mark_shown checks it durably and independently.
items.D3: stdlib filesystem/SQLite lock and existing public connection, redactor, secret guard, configuration, fault and clock interfaces; no new dependency.
items.D4: One module below 400 lines; nine public operations include lifecycle, serialized delivery and integrity read model.
items.D5: tests/unit/test_agent_mail.py exercises synthetic bridge files and SQLite; plans/mutate_agent_mail_2026-11-05.sh removes protections and requires failing behavioral assertions.
items.D6: Wire contract is docs/reference/agent_mail_bridge.md. Intake is persisted before ack; quota survives retry. Bridge authenticates sender/owner; health never chooses from.

disposability.rationale: Replaceable using the wire contract, the declared lifecycle and behavioral tests; no dependency on bridge implementation or model behavior.
